judgment_calls.decision: Finding of foot region (descendants match) as the foot-symptoms complaint in both tasks and the priority rule
Two check tasks: red box, and the 'not needing urgent attention' approach (B's structure)
White discoloration of skin at Skin structure of lower limb

judgment_calls.decision: Peripheral pulse absent (page says 'in the leg', not foot; already in VHA vocabulary)

judgment_calls.topic: Muscle pain in legs or buttocks on exercise
judgment_calls.decision: Intermittent claudication for the CLI red-box item only; plain muscle pain at leg/buttock for the PVD branch, which does not say 'on exercise'
judgment_calls.alternatives: Muscle pain with an exercise qualifier; claudication also in PVD

judgment_calls.topic: Sudden severe foot pain at rest
judgment_calls.decision: One Foot pain finding with Sudden onset, Severe and At rest qualifiers; foot pain at rest (CLI) as Foot pain with At rest
judgment_calls.alternatives: Separate Pain provoked by rest at Foot structure finding

judgment_calls.decision: Thick skin AND Scaly skin at the same site for sole, heel and border of foot
judgment_calls.alternatives: Scaly skin alone (fires more often); lateral/medial border separately

judgment_calls.decision: Neuropathy and PVD require Foot pain with Generalized qualifier; localised rules use their specific findings without a Localized qualifier
judgment_calls.alternatives: Plain foot pain (fires more often); Localized foot pain in bunion/plantar fasciitis

judgment_calls.decision: 'Constant', 'worse at night', 'on starting walking' not encoded; rules fire more often than the page intends
Hallux valgus AND bunion (bony lump = Bony swelling of toe joint at first MTP joint); Peripheral nerve disease
judgment_calls.alternatives: Swelling of first metatarsophalangeal joint of hallux; Mass of body region
